description: The signed-in couple's own wedding budget on Zola: add 1 payment to 1 budget item, paid or scheduled. Get the item_id from zola_get_my_budget first. A scheduled payment needs due_on. A paid payment needs paid_on, the day that the couple paid in her time zone. No money moves: Zola only records the payment, and sends no reminder for it. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Each confirm adds 1 payment. Status possible_duplicate: the item has an equal payment, and Zola added nothing: ask the couple, and give the match_id of each equal payment in ignore_match_ids to add a second one. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

amount_cents.description: The amount of the payment, in cents

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

due_on.description: The due day, YYYY-MM-DD. Necessary for scheduled

ignore_match_ids.description: The match_id of each equal payment of a possible_duplicate preview, when the couple says that she wants a second equal payment

paid_on.description: Necessary for paid: the day that the couple paid, YYYY-MM-DD, in the time zone of the couple. Not after today

status.description: paid: the couple paid it. scheduled: the couple pays it later, on due_on

name: zola_add_my_vendor_payment

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a payment added to the budget of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the budget

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_add_my_vendor_payment with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The new payments with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_get_my_budget gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Add My Vendor Payment
